Awaiting responses for:

> @Alex-302 Did you see my other comment regarding the overlay promo? 
> https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/issues/243199#issuecomment-6047355377 
> Files were sent for you to the QA email address. _([Source](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/issues/243199#issuecomment-6119890598))_


and for:


> > I see only direct links.
> 
> @Alex-302 Can confirm that the "goto" URL behaviour is being slowly rolled out to everyone by Google: https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardForMac/issues/1790#issuecomment-6122813821
> 
> So is it worth hopping onto this early? Is this considered a privacy issue? _([Source](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/issues/243199#issuecomment-6122849804))_
